title: Adversarial Review Evaluation v1
description: Schema for evaluation.json — structural run metrics produced at the end of a risk-adaptive adversarial review invocation (issue #350, ADR-0027). Produced only on triggering runs; non-triggering runs produce no evaluation.json. Token telemetry is out of scope (INV-021).

branch_slug.description: Slugified branch name; matches the report directory name under reports/adversarial-review/.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of evaluation.json creation (end of the run).

report_path.description: Repo-relative path to the corresponding report.md (e.g. reports/adversarial-review/feat-foo/report.md).

trigger_reasons.description: One or more of the ADR-0027 firing predicates that caused this run. At least one must be present (or the run should not have been triggered).

reviewer_launch_count.description: Number of reviewer agent launches during this run. Expected: 2 (Phase 1 A + B); additional launches from Phase R or recovery are included.

continuation_status.description: Whether each reviewer was resumed in their existing context (preferred) or re-launched fresh (fallback) for the cross-critique phase.

reviewer_a.description: resumed: reviewer context survived through Phase 1. fresh_fallback: context was lost; a fresh context was launched for Phase 2. unavailable: Phase 2 could not run for this reviewer.

finding_counts.description: Finding counts from the integrated Phase 1+2 report.

phase1_total.description: Total findings from Phase 1 (both reviewers combined).

cross_critique_new.description: New findings surfaced during Phase 2 (IDs matching *-C*).

by_severity.description: Adopted findings after synthesis, keyed by final severity.

adopted.description: Number of findings adopted (confirmed) in the synthesis.

rejected.description: Number of findings rejected or re-scoped in the synthesis.

basis_counts.description: Distribution of cross-critique verdict basis kinds (issue #347, cross-critique.v1.schema.json).

code_evidence.description: Number of verdicts backed by code_evidence citations.

spec_evidence.description: Number of verdicts backed by spec_evidence citations.

concern.description: Number of verdicts labelled as concern (no verifiable citation).

propose_reject_accepted.description: PROPOSE-REJECT verdicts accepted by the human (finding removed from remediation plan).

propose_reject_overridden.description: PROPOSE-REJECT verdicts that the human declined (finding retained despite the proposal).

scope_counts.description: Distribution of scope assessments across all cross-critique verdicts (issue #348).

out_of_scope.description: Findings labelled out_of_scope. None of these should appear in the implementation TODO list.

unclear.description: Findings labelled unclear. Each requires a human decision before any fix is requested.

human_dispositions.description: Optional. Human decisions on individual findings (e.g. overrides of PROPOSE-REJECT, scope rulings on unclear findings).

disposition.description: The human's decision on this finding.

ran.description: Whether Phase R was executed for this run.

not_ran_reason.description: Present when ran == false. Explains why (e.g. 'no fixes landed yet', 'zero adopted findings').

verified_count.description: Number of findings verified as VERIFIED in Phase R.

new_issues_found.description: V-* findings introduced by fixes, per Phase R.

duration_ms.description: Optional. Wall-clock duration of the full run in milliseconds, if the orchestrator can measure it.

notes.description: Optional. Free-form orchestrator notes (e.g. recovery actions taken, anomalies).
